top_choice_rationale: Kane, Mele and Molenkamp: the Z2 classification of time-reversal-invariant, spin-orbit insulators is a new way of organising phases of matter, it predicts a computable band-structure invariant and protected helical edge channels, and Molenkamp's HgTe wells tested that prediction. The interpretation has been stable for fifteen years or more across many materials. The 2016 overlap can be handled by a citation tied to the Z2 invariant and time-reversal symmetry, not the integer Chern number. The Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan omissions are real weaknesses in the allocation, but they do not outweigh the conceptual weight, so P001 (clean two-name credit, but a measurement advance on an area honoured in 2005 and 2012) is second and no award last.
